title: Vietnam infrastructure repair costs: not modeled

claims.text: This assessment does not model government infrastructure repair costs. Its scope covers agriculture, forestry and fishing value added and conditional government revenue transmission; no infrastructure damage or repair cost channel is estimated, so it implies nothing specific about Vietnam infrastructure repair spending.

limitations: Infrastructure repair costs are outside the assessment's model scope; no damage function or repair-cost estimate exists for Vietnam or any country in this bundle.
The revenue loss figure measures government revenue shortfalls relative to a no-event counterfactual, not damage or reconstruction expenditure.
Results are conditional on the ENSO outlook vintage and are not causal attributions.
Historical input provenance is incomplete; the bundle is flagged for inspection only and is not recomputable.
All monetary values are in constant 2025 USD at a fixed 2025 exchange rate.
